lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance circular pixel clusters are arranged in a roughly orthogonal grid pattern; spot diameter increases and spatial density decreases along the anterior-to-posterior axis.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity are visible, intersecting the horizontal alignment of blobs to form a grid-like nodal structure across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal linear ridge is visible on the upper third of the flank, exhibiting a sharp vertical luminance gradient with high-intensity pixels on the dorsal edge and a distinct shadow on the ventral edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A small, irregular high-luminance mark (possible scar) is located on the upper dorsal region; a thin, trailing filamentous structure or remora is attached to the posterior trailing edge of the pectoral fin.
other_distinctive_markers: Strongly defined caustic light network refracted from the water surface is superimposed on the dermal patterning; several commensal fish are visible in the surrounding water column.
